name: IREN AI Datacenter Infrastructure Transition Valuation
rationale: IREN Limited (IREN) is converting its 1.4GW+ power pipeline into AI GPU cloud datacenters. TTM revenue reached $501.0M. Accounting for share dilution (394.1M shares), 5-year DCF yields $29.03 (-17.8% vs $35.31 current at 9.14% WACC). Wall Street consensus of $78.19 reflects full megawatt monetization. Recommendation: MAINTAIN (Core Holding: 28.0 shares, 2.72% target weight). Maintain current position size, accumulate on pullbacks near $34.63, and execute partial trims above $44.00.

risks: ATM equity issuance diluting per-share earnings power
